title: Vegan Beetroot and Tofu Curry
subtitle: with Curry Leaves and Coconut Milk
description: Taking inspiration from Sri Lanka, where curry leaves are a key ingredient, this beautiful veggie curry is sure to be a dinnertime hit. Tuck into vibrant, earthy beetroot and golden satay tofu in a mild, yet flavour-packed sauce. Bliss!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil for the rice. Peel the beetroot and cut into 1cm-thick wedges (see Kitchen hack). Thinly slice the onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Pick the curry leaves, discarding the stems.

Fry aromatics: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and curry leaves, stirring, for 5 mins or until the onion is soft. Season with salt and pepper. Add the masala seasoning and garlic and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Stir in 2 tsp white vinegar and cook, stirring, for 30 secs.

Simmer curry: Add the beetroot, coconut milk and 180ml (¾ cup) water to the onion mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 20-25 mins until the beetroot is tender and the curry is thickened.

Boil rice and warm tofu: Meanwhile, cook the rice in the pan of boiling water for 12 mins or until tender. Drain and cover to keep warm. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan and thinly slice.
Serve up: Taste the curry, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice and beetroot curry among bowls, top with the tofu and enjoy!

Kitchen hack: Beetroot can be messy to prepare. Before you start, put on disposable or rubber gloves to prevent your hands from turning pink, and if you're using a plastic chopping board, rub a little oil over it to prevent staining.
